title: Provider failure taxonomy extended from two classes to the complete ten-member vocabulary

mapping.phaseTimeouts: TIMEOUT/HUNG_CHILD/HUNG_GRANDCHILD -> PROBE or RUNTIME timeout by callPhase
mapping.localCli: spawn error other than ENOENT, CLI_CRASH, CANCELLED
mapping.invalidResponse: MALFORMED_OUTPUT, GARBAGE_OUTPUT, OVERSIZE_OUTPUT, PARTIAL_OUTPUT, SECRET_ECHO, UNKNOWN_INTENT, UNSAFE_INTENT, UNKNOWN_TOOL, UNAUTHORIZED_ENVIRONMENT
mapping.authQuota: NONZERO_EXIT or PROVIDER_FAILURE plus bounded enumerated text signal (auth wins over quota)
mapping.unknown: no class, no timeout, or PROVIDER_FAILURE without a signal

sanitization.secretEchoPath: SECRET_ECHO never scans the echoed body

commands.command: npx playwright test reasonerCli, reasonerPrint, reasonerPrintW9, agentProtocol, agentRuntime, agentRuntimeW9, localCampaign, localCampaignByteAccounting, w13 suites
